name: – Javi López, Borja Giménez Larraz – § 49 – Am 33
title: INTERIM REPORT in view of the consent procedure on the Political, Economic and Cooperation Strategic Partnership Agreement between the EU and Mexico
part_text: 49. Commends the inclusion of a dedicated chapter on trade and sustainable development (TSD); regrets, however, that these provisions lack effective enforcement mechanisms and sanctions and therefore fall short of the EU’s updated TSD approach; calls for the inclusion of sanctions for non-compliance with labour, environmental and climate commitments, and for the Paris Agreement to be recognised as an essential element of the Agreement; notes that, in the event of violations, these commitments are only subject to recommendations by independent panels of experts; believes the commitments made in the TSD chapter are not sufficient to balance the social and environmental risks posed by the proposed agreed trade liberalisation;
